facts.text: Drawing attention to the scale of the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan, the Union Health Minister stated that over 25 crore people have been covered under intensified TB screening , with more than 11 crore chest X-rays and 3 crore molecular tests conducted.

The WHO Global Tuberculosis Report 2026 documents India's highest-ever reduction in estimated TB mortality, with the mortality rate declining from 28 deaths per lakh population in 2015 to 18 deaths per lakh in 2025 .
